theatres.fullReview: People-pleasing cop Baby accepts a fake charge to get leave for her sister-in-law’s baby shower in Rewa. Defying dismissive in-laws, an indifferent husband and an apathetic local police force, she secretly investigates the murder, uncovering family betrayals while finding her own voice, courage and place as a real cop.
